rules.title: Never edit applied migrations
rules.text: Never edit a migration that has been applied anywhere; add a new migration instead.

rules.title: Ordered, descriptive versions
rules.text: Use ordered version numbers and descriptive names, and keep one logical change per migration.

rules.title: Backward compatible steps
rules.text: Write migrations so the previous application version still works, and drop old columns in a later release.

rules.title: Test on realistic data
rules.text: Run migrations against a production-like copy in CI before releasing.

rules.title: Repeatable migrations for code objects
rules.text: Use repeatable migrations only for views and functions that can be safely recreated.
